Part Number: TBX-750FA-V2


                                                      SPARKLE Thunderbolt™ eGPU Studio-G 750, Thunderbolt™ 3 40Gbps, 4-Slot
                                                      PCIe Graphics Enclosure, 750W PSU, USB & Ethernet Ports, Windows/MacOS
                                                      Compatible, TBX-750FA-V2
                                                      Powered by Intel® Alpine Ridge, SPARKLE Thunderbolt™ eGPU Studio-G 750 is designed for boosting
                                                      up the graphics ability of your laptop by plug-in an external PCIe GPU.
                                                      Studio Series has the biggest ability to fit the latest GPU in the marketing, Studio-G 750 supports the
                                                      GPU with up to 4-Slot width and 346mm length; a built-in 750W PSU is ready to face any challenge.
